title: tarenna ridleyi
intro: Tarenna ridleyi, commonly known as the Himalayan Tarenna, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Tarenna ridleyi include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and antidiabetic activities, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern research. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
